scope: Links, buttons and check boxes work in your own Chrome again, even with Companion in front. The browser extension links tabs more reliably.

topics.title: Old Chrome extension
details: Some copies of the Chrome extension are too old to update.
If yours is one, Companion now tells you each time it starts.
Chapter 18 of the guide has the steps to replace it. Look for Replace an old extension.

topics.title: Links and buttons in your own Chrome
details: Links, buttons, check boxes and radio buttons work again in your own Chrome.
Before, a click could wait 10 seconds and then say the page did not load cleanly.
This happened when Companion's window was in front of Chrome.
Lists, menus and YouTube buttons work the same way now.

topics.title: Searches and forms
details: Pressing Enter in a search box or form is quick again.

topics.title: Pages that close or fail
details: If a page closes its own tab, you go on in a tab that is still open.
If a website says a page is missing, you hear that first.

topics.title: Browser extension
details: A tab that could not link at first now links when it loads again.
The tab you are on links when you open Web browser.
